ai.description: *Amolops nyingchiensis* is a medium-sized frog (40–50 mm) with a brown, mottled dorsum and pale yellow belly. It features a distinct white upper lip stripe and expanded adhesive discs on its digits.
ai.identificationRemarks: *Amolops nyingchiensis* is best distinguished by the presence of a distinct, continuous dorsolateral fold, which is absent or significantly interrupted in most similar species.
ai.habitat: The Nyingchi Cascade Frog inhabits high-altitude mountain streams and rocky torrents within temperate forests, typically found at elevations between 2,000 and 3,500 meters.
ai.behavior: The Nyingchi Cascade Frog is primarily nocturnal, actively hunting for small invertebrates along the rocky, fast-flowing mountain streams it inhabits after dark.
ai.reproductionNotes: *Amolops nyingchiensis* is an oviparous breeder that lays eggs in mountain streams. Breeding occurs during the monsoon season, typically from June to August.
ai.distributionRemarks: The Nyingchi Cascade Frog occurs in the Eastern Himalayas of Arunachal Pradesh, India, typically inhabiting high-altitude streams between 2,000 and 3,000 meters.
ai.callDescription: The Nyingchi Cascade Frog produces a series of short, high-pitched "peep" notes, typically heard near the rushing waters of mountain streams.
